entries.78fcde4cd1ba6e49: The business concludes outsourcing or temporary staffing contracts with client companies, and either re-outsources work to registered professional talent or employs such talent on fixed-term contracts and dispatches them to client companies. Many of the projects involve core system development from requirements definition to basic design, as well as strategy formulation, PMO, IT and business improvement consulting, and the business specializes in individuals with advanced capabilities commanding high person-month rates. The company also provides recruitment support for regular employment as a licensed employment placement service. The group has a single segment, the Professional Talent Business, and revenue by business is not disclosed.
